Indian boxers secure multiple medals at Commonwealth Games

Indian boxers Preeti and Jaismine have advanced to the finals of their respective weight categories at the Commonwealth Games 2026. Preeti secured a unanimous win in her semi-final bout, with judges scoring the rounds 10-8 in her favor. Arundhati Choudhary also reached the 70kg final, guaranteeing India at least a silver medal. India's boxing contingent has guaranteed a total of 10 medals, with a perfect 6/6 day in boxing events.
